mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupons ( user_id, coupon_id, coupon_name, coupon_amount, expire_time, status, order_id, use_time, coupon_type, min_order_amount, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{couponId}, #{couponName}, #{couponAmount}, #{expireTime}, #{status}, #{orderId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{useTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{couponType}, #{minOrderAmount}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, coupon_id AS couponId, coupon_name AS couponName, coupon_amount AS couponAmount, expire_time AS expireTime, status, order_id AS orderId, use_time AS useTime, coupon_type AS couponType, min_order_amount AS minOrderAmount, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM user_coupons WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT coupon_id as couponId, coupon_name as couponName, coupon_amount as couponAmount, coupon_type as couponType, min_order_amount as minOrderAmount, expire_time as expireTime, status as status, create_time as createTime FROM user_coupons WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 -- 未使用 AND expire_time > NOW() -- 未过期 AND ( coupon_type = 1 -- 无门槛券 OR ( coupon_type = 2 -- 满减券 AND ( min_order_amount IS NULL -- 没有最低限制 OR #{orderAmount} >= min_order_amount -- 订单金额满足最低要求 ) ) ) ORDER BY coupon_amount DESC, expire_time ASC
